topics.title: Anchor 1: Generate and conceptualize artistic ideas and work

outcomes.text: With support, move between imagination and reality in dramatic play and make props and costume pieces from simple materials.

topics.title: Anchor 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas and work

outcomes.text: With support, add gestures and words to dramatic play and express original ideas.

topics.title: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work

outcomes.text: With support, answer questions in dramatic play and spot similarities and differences in sounds and movements.

topics.title: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation

outcomes.text: With support, identify characters in dramatic play and use body, face, gestures and voice to show traits and emotions.

topics.title: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques and work for presentation

outcomes.text: With support, understand that imagination is fundamental to dramatic play and explore technical elements.

topics.title: Anchor 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work

outcomes.text: With support, take part in dramatic play or a guided drama experience.

topics.title: Anchor 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work

outcomes.text: With support, recall an emotional response in dramatic play and name and describe characters.

topics.title: Anchor 8: Interpret intent and meaning in artistic work

outcomes.text: With support, explore preferences in dramatic play or theatre; compare personal emotions with a character's, using words or pictures.

topics.title: Anchor 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work

outcomes.text: With support, engage in dramatic play; identify props and costumes; compare characters' experiences.

topics.title: Anchor 10: Synthesize and relate knowledge and personal experiences to make art

outcomes.text: With support, spot similarities between a story and personal experience in dramatic play.

topics.title: Anchor 11: Relate artistic ideas and works with societal, cultural, and historical context to deepen understanding

outcomes.text: With support, use skills and knowledge from other areas in dramatic play.
With support, spot stories that differ from one another and tell a short story in dramatic play.

topics.title: Anchor 10: Synthesize and relate knowledge and personal experiences to make art

topics.title: Anchor 1: Generate and conceptualize artistic ideas and work
